claim: Decaf native libraries and exact consumer integrations; not deployment or Shieldd circuit certification

assumptions.kernel: Rocq kernel and foundational logic are trusted; no arithmetic axioms or dummy semantics.
assumptions.extraction: Exact reviewed extraction tools and binary lifting are trusted translations, not proved by regression tests.
assumptions.analysis: Exact binary analyzer and SMT solver correctness are trusted; complete exploration and nonvacuity remain checked obligations.
assumptions.compiler: Functional compiler correspondence is trusted; compiled trace properties require separate evidence for exact binaries.
assumptions.environment: Explicit public scheduling and OS entry-state model; reached secret-sensitive runtime operations cannot be omitted.
assumptions.randomness: Named entropy, independence, and distribution assumptions must be instantiated for each protocol.
assumptions.cryptography: Exact computational and hash-model assumptions must be bound to each protocol reduction.
assumptions.physical: Instruction latency, speculation, power/EM, faults, physical erasure, and restored/forked process snapshots are outside the certificate.

field-constants.scope: Shared Fq/Fr primality, bounds and limb-conversion arithmetic with explicit Pocklington certificates; not native execution or curve/group refinement

binary-flow-controls.scope: Differential candidate decoder flow, leak, unsupported-instruction and incomplete-analysis controls; not full binary lifting qualification

fiat-typed-multiplication.scope: Exact-option typed Fiat multiplication after fresh source-bound import build; native execution and printer correspondence remain required

binary-controls.scope: Candidate BINSEC C controls for both instruction sets; not full tool, library, consumer or native ARM64 qualification

rust-carry.scope: Rust32 carry helper; not complete field, default backend, or binary coverage

rust-fq-add.scope: Rust32 Fq addition and helpers; native multiplication remains open

go-helpers.scope: Go word and array support under explicit semantics contracts

go-field-add.scope: Go Fq/Fr addition and same-array aliases under explicit semantics contracts
